text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening questions and statement","quality":"argument focus","description":"The essay states a position early and keeps returning to the same claim that driverless cars are unsafe."},{"evidence":"three labeled reasons with body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured, with an introduction, separate support points, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"article quotations in each body paragraph","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses specific details from the source article to back up each reason."},{"evidence":"explains work zones, malfunctions, and liability","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its claims with multiple consequences and examples rather than brief assertions."},{"evidence":"repeated explanation of crash risk and fault","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more fully connects evidence to its conclusion by explaining how the article’s facts lead to danger and legal problems."}]}
